title: GIF cut-out masks compose: Add / Subtract over All / Frame / Selected

reason: Porting the image workspace's run -> candidate -> Add / Subtract commit onto the GIF cut-out panel, with the existing All / Frame / Selected scope saying where it lands.

summary: Shipped a6c423db. 16/16 GIF desktop specs, 1595 node tests, and maskCompose proven on real pixels in Chromium (8 cases). Two spec assertions read the other way before the fix: an empty run no longer wipes the frame, and a colour key that matches nothing leaves the tracked mask alone.
maturity in-progress -> validating: awaiting Fabio on whether a proposal needs its own tint colour, since it is the one time the highlight is not what disappears.

Fabio answered the open tint question: a proposal wears --accent-ok green, a committed mask keeps --mask-fill white (relayed as board message 2a2cfb4f). Shipped on both surfaces (CSS tint + MpiCanvas.setMaskDisplayProposal), proven red by backing the flag out, and the two comments asserting the dead pre-MPI-859 carve-out are rewritten. Stays validating: only Fabio's eyes on a real clip are left.

Fabio live-checked the tint and overturned the display model: the store now holds WHAT GETS CUT and is drawn as itself (the image workspace model, ported), Background masks the background, and the whole MPI-771 complement translation is deleted. 16/16 GIF desktop specs, 1599 node tests, pixel proof on disk for Background -> Add -> Cut out. Stays validating for his eyes.
